title: Desenvolvedor de software em teste
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and Playwright
  • Develop test cases and test plans for assigned user stories in JIRA
  • Perform functional, regression, and exploratory testing on Android and iOS builds
  • Log, triage, and track defects in JIRA with clear reproduction steps and evidence
  • Collaborate with Android and iOS developers to support unit and integration testing
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline test execution and report on automation results
  • Participate in sprint planning and provide QA effort estimates for user stories
  • Follow automation framework standards established by the Senior SDET
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies: standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 5+ years of QA automation or SDET experience
  • Solid proficiency with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright
  • Programming experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript
  • Experience with mobile testing using Appium or native mobile test frameworks
  • Familiarity with JIRA for defect tracking, test case management, and sprint participation
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests
  • Ability to analyze test failures and provide clear, actionable bug reports
  • Working knowledge of Test Driven Development (TDD) practices and the ability to support TDD adoption within the team
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum QA practices
  • Experience with BDD/Cucumber or similar behavior-driven frameworks
  • Exposure to Firebase Test Lab, AWS Device Farm, or similar cloud test platforms
  • Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or RestAssured

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Mobile QA Engineer
description:
Mobile QA Engineer

Location: LATAM

Looking for a talented and motivated Quality Test Engineer to contribute to the mission of helping the world’s farmers sustainably increase productivity using digital tools, mobile software, advanced analytics and high quality assurance standards. This role is a unique opportunity to join our dynamic Brazil laboratory, responsible for testing the web & mobile apps that will operate under extreme environments and help ensure a great experience for our customers.

You will work on creating Test Plans and Test Cases and in most cases performing the manual testing based on those Test Plans and Test Cases. You will ensure our applications are accurate, robust, scalable, performant and deployable, and will have the opportunity to work with large, "big data" sets such as scientific data, machine generated data from our farmer's equipment to geospatial data, precision agriculture, remote sensing, weather and soil data. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering and business partners to enable a seamless, high-quality experience for our customers.

What You Will Do:

  • Pair up with software engineers, product owners and test engineers to deliver manual test suites to validate our web and mobile (iOS, Android) applications
  • Test our applications with different locales to guarantee a valuable global product experience to our customers, going to the field when necessary
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers to ensure the data and software tools they use are accurate and reliable
  • Write up test strategies, test plans, design documents, and whatever else may be needed
  • Actively engage in root cause analysis reviews
  • Assist in ongoing process improvement efforts to ensure test planning, execution, and reporting is effective and efficient
  • Create detailed incident reports for production issues, and work on triage and investigation
  • Be willing to take on other responsibilities and tackle a variety of engineering and testing problems - we are a small team and all share role
  • Be willing to be a representative of the QA team on a project and lead all test activities that are needed

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience
  • Strong self-starter who will work closely and daily with an existing team of other self-starters
  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may be accepted
  • Nice to have: Agriculture degree with QA knowledge and experience
  • Understanding the SDLC and the tester role and responsibility within it
  • You understand deadlines and the need to deliver the most valuable things first
  • English fluency
  • You will communicate with US based teams on a daily basis and bridge any communication gaps between English and non-English team members
  • at least B2 level of English, Cambridge or similar certification is a Plus
  • Understanding of common user interface design patterns and software quality assurance methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile teams, experience in SAFe is a Plus

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with blackbox testing
  • Strong experience with web
  • Medium experience with mobile and API testing
  • ISTQB certification is a Plus
  • basic programmer knowledge is a Plus

We also hinge our cultural DNA on these five values:

  • Inspire one another
  • Innovate in all we do
  • Leave a mark on the world
  • Find the possible in the impossible
  • Be direct and transparent

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.

If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.g., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).

  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Brazil
description:
About Group-IB

Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses and citizens and support law enforcement operations.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.

Each of us can help make the world a safer place.

Join us!

The role:

As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.

This role is ideal for a motivated, self-starting sales professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets

Tasks to solve:

  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Develops and implements sales strategies, manages sales pipelines, and monitors performance to achieve sales goals.
  • Team Leadership: Leads and motivates a sales team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and ensures customer satisfaction.
  • Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals.
  • Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM.
  • Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity.
  • Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Role-based in São Paulo.
  • Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team.
  • Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating.
  • Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans.
  • Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools

Why GROUP-IB?

  • Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy.
  • Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area.
  • Group-IB.A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? By choosing us, you will be choosing complex tasks and continuously improving your skills in a fast-growing international company .
  • Globally recognized technologies: Group-IB's members are located in 25 countries, and our products and services are sold in 60 countries. What’s more, Gartner, IDC, and Forrester have ranked our technologies among the best in their class. We work with over 450 international partners and about 500 clients .
  • A culture created by each of us: Group-IB’s employees speak many different languages and understand one another. We respect each other's beliefs, share common values, and strive toward the happiness of every employee .
  • Economic stability: Group-IB's sustainable growth helps rapidly develop careers that would take years to progress as far as most other companies.

What else should you know:

  • Flexible schedule: Group-IB does not have fixed working hours. You choose your schedule. We adhere to the principle advocated by Steve Jobs: “We have to work not 12 hours and head. ”Health: If anything goes wrong, don’t worry — we offer health insurance.
  • Certificates and training courses : Group-IB specialists hold over 1,000 professional certificates, including CEH, CISSP, OSCP, GIAC, MCFE, BSI, as well as some rare ones that would be a source of pride for experts in forensics, penetration testing, and reverse engineering worldwide. We have an incentive program that helps employees achieve certifications at the company's expense.
  • Challenges: A wide selection of GIB programs helps you improve soft skills, gain new competencies, and receive monetary rewards.
  • The initiative is rewarded: At Group-IB, you can bring your most daring ideas to life. The company encourages technical blogging, writing articles, building sports teams, and other creative activities.

title: Strategic Planning & Consumer Insights Senior Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Strategic Planning & Consumer Insights Senior Manager | Samsung Electronics

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP.
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Description

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager to lead our Big Data and Consumer Market Insights (CMI) initiatives, playing a pivotal role in translating complex consumer data into actionable insights that shape business strategy. As a key team member, you’ll analyze consumer behavior, identify trends, and drive data-based decisions, aligning closely with cross-functional teams to enhance the customer journey and address critical business needs. This role is an excellent opportunity for a data leader with strong analytical and communication skills who thrives on influencing business outcomes.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive big data strategy that aligns with business objectives and leverages cutting-edge technologies (cloud platforms, machine learning, AI).
  • Oversee the collection, processing, and analysis of diverse data sources, including consumer interactions, product usage, social media, and market trends.
  • Apply advanced analytics to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that address business challenges and drive innovation.
  • Develop predictive models and algorithms to anticipate consumer behavior and market dynamics.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (product, marketing, sales) to translate data insights into actionable strategies and product roadmaps. By understanding business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.
  • Communicate complex data findings in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. And drive the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools that allow business units to make informed, data-backed decisions.
  • Stay ahead of the curve by exploring and evaluating emerging technologies in big data and analytics (e.g., data lakes, real-time analytics). Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Build a thriving Big Data Community across LATAM: Foster a collaborative network of data professionals across Samsung subsidiaries in Latin America. This community will serve as a platform for knowledge sharing, best practice development, and driving a data-driven culture across the region. You will empower these individuals to become evangelists for data-driven decision-making within their respective operations, with a strong focus on achieving measurable business results and contributing to Samsung's overall success in the LATAM market.
  • Design and execute innovative market research studies (surveys, focus groups, customer interviews) to gather qualitative and quantitative data on consumer needs and preferences. And lead data analysis strategies that extract and interpret patterns in consumer data to understand behaviors, needs, and preferences.
  • Analyze market research data to identify key trends, competitive landscape, and opportunities for differentiation. Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the consumer electronics market, emerging trends (e.g., IoT, smart home), and Samsung's competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate consumer insights into product development, marketing campaigns, and go-to-market strategies. By identify business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics or other relevant areas.
  • Experience in a data-driven role, with leadership responsibilities.
  • Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data insights to business objectives, anticipate future trends, and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • A deep understanding of consumer behavior, empathy for customer needs, and a passion for uncovering their motivations and pain points.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Able to convey complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, build consensus, and influence stakeholders.
  • A strong team player with proven ability to build relationships, foster a data-driven culture, and collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Driven to achieve goals, exceed expectations, and deliver impactful results that contribute to Samsung's success. Adept at using data to solve real business problems, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Proven expertise in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), statistical analysis tools (R, Python), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI). Advanced Excel.
  • Advanced English skills, Spanish will be considered a plus.

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Senior Quality Analyst (Gen AI)

Garantir a qualidade em sistemas de IA Generativa é um desafio único: as respostas podem ser não-determinísticas. Sua missão será desenhar e implementar estratégias de testes que validem não apenas o código, mas a precisão, segurança e confiabilidade dos nossos sistemas agênticos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia de Testes de IA: Criar frameworks para validar saídas de LLMs, combatendo alucinações, vieses e garantindo a aderência ao contexto.
  • Automação: Desenvolver e manter scripts de automação de testes (E2E, API e Integração) utilizando ferramentas como Playwright ou Cypress.
  • Shift-left Testing: Atuar desde a fase de requisitos para garantir que a qualidade seja pensada no início do desenvolvimento.
  • Testes de Performance e Segurança: Validar a resiliência das integrações com modelos de IA e a segurança contra vulnerabilidades como prompt injection.
  • Monitoramento de Qualidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade e bugs, reportando resultados para o time global.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência avançada em automação de testes e ferramentas de QA.
  • Conhecimento em Python (para scripts de teste e validação de dados).
  • Inglês Avançado: Capacidade de interagir e reportar resultados para times internacionais.
  • Desejável: Experiência anterior testando aplicações que consomem APIs de LLM (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).

title: Consultor Funcional KU - Finanças (SAP FICA)
description:
Consultor Funcional KU – Finanças (SAP FICA)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará junto ao time de Finanças, com foco no módulo SAP FICA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable), apoiando a sustentação e evolução de processos financeiros. Seu papel será garantir o bom funcionamento das rotinas relacionadas a contas a receber e a pagar, atuando na interface entre usuários de negócio e soluções tecnológicas. Além disso, contribuirá na validação de soluções funcionais, análise de incidentes e identificação de melhorias, assegurando que os processos estejam alinhados às necessidades do negócio.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar usuários da área financeira na utilização do SAP FICA, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando o uso correto do sistema.
  • Executar e acompanhar rotinas financeiras relacionadas ao módulo FICA, garantindo a consistência dos processos.
  • Validar soluções funcionais ligadas a contas a receber e contas a pagar.
  • Executar testes funcionais, acompanhar correções e garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar na análise de incidentes, identificando causas e apoiando na resolução.
  • Contribuir com a identificação de melhorias contínuas nos processos financeiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio e times técnicos, garantindo alinhamento entre necessidade e solução.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com SAP FICA, atuando em processos relacionados a contas a receber e/ou contas a pagar;
  • Conhecimento de processos financeiros e contábeis, com entendimento prático das rotinas de negócio;
  • Capacidade de validar soluções funcionais e garantir aderência aos processos financeiros;
  • Experiência com execução de testes funcionais e acompanhamento de correções;
  • Vivência na análise e tratamento de incidentes, com foco em identificação de causa raiz;
  • Boa compreensão do impacto das soluções tecnológicas nos processos de negócio;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com usuários e áreas técnicas.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência em ambientes SAP com atuação próxima ao negócio;
  • Possuir vivência com melhorias contínuas e otimização de processos financeiros;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices

Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

description:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).

Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.

How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Analista de TI com foco em integrações e sustentação evolutiva, sendo responsável por garantir a estabilidade e evolução das integrações entre sistemas críticos. Seu papel envolverá tanto a análise técnica e resolução de incidentes quanto a construção e evolução de integrações via APIs e serviços, conectando diferentes plataformas como SAP, Salesforce e outros sistemas corporativos. Além disso, você contribuirá com decisões técnicas relacionadas à arquitetura de integrações e à observabilidade dos ambientes, garantindo confiabilidade, performance e rastreabilidade das soluções.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Analisar e resolver incidentes técnicos em ambientes produtivos, atuando com troubleshooting e identificação de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir integrações entre sistemas, utilizando APIs e padrões corporativos.
  • Apoiar o desenho e a evolução da arquitetura de integrações, garantindo escalabilidade e consistência.
  • Atuar no monitoramento e observabilidade das soluções, utilizando ferramentas como Datadog.
  • Trabalhar com diferentes sistemas e plataformas, como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Salesforce e WSO2.
  • Gerir e priorizar o backlog técnico, alinhando demandas entre diferentes áreas de TI.
  • Colaborar com times técnicos diversos, garantindo integração e fluidez entre sistemas e processos.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em análise técnica e sustentação de sistemas, com atuação em ambientes produtivos e resolução de incidentes.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento e manutenção de integrações entre sistemas, utilizando APIs e serviços web.
  • Experiência com plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Salesforce e/ou ferramentas de integração como WSO2.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web e conceitos de integração (REST, mensageria, autenticação, etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, como Datadog ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais, com domínio de SQL para análise e troubleshooting.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma hands-on, com autonomia e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas.
  • Boa comunicação técnica e habilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas de TI.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência mais aprofundada em arquitetura de integrações;
  • Possuir vivência com ambientes complexos e distribuídos;
  • Tiver familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade e melhoria contínua.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Engenheiro eletrônico
description:
ATIVIDADE: Desenvolvimento de sistemas eletrônicos embarcados com foco no desenvolvimento de SOFTWARE (Firmware)

RESUMO

O profissional escolhido estará inserido no time de Eletrônica (RnD USA) da Engenharia do Produto de uma multinacional, trabalhando com foco no desenvolvimento de software (FIRMWARE) de projetos de sistemas embarcados que respaldam as funcionalidades avançadas de controle em produtos de Home Appliances.

Ou seja, irá prover liderança técnica e expertise no desenvolvimento de soluções eletrônicas, desde a sua concepção até a produção em si.

FORMAÇÃO

Formação superior ou cursando Engenharia de Software ou Engenharia Eletrônica.

Mestrado é um diferencial.

AMBIENTE DE TRABALHO

Engenharia do Produto, Departamento de Eletrônica (projetos EUA).

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver especificações de software/firmware com base em uma variedade de requisitos, incluindo design de consumidor, marketing e industrial, e especificação de produto;
  • Liderar e participar de todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software embarcado, como projeto de software, codificação, depuração, verificação, validação etc.;
  • Realizar revisão de projeto de software e revisão de código;
  • Executar análise estática de código, testes de caixa branca, testes de caixa cinza e participar da preparação e execução de planos de validação de firmware;
  • Desenvolver software de interface de usuário para PC, permitindo que engenheiros configurem, depurem e façam os diagnósticos das placas embarcadas;
  • Desenvolver documentação detalhada de engenharia, incluindo documentos de projeto de software, especificações, manuais e outras documentações do cliente, procedimentos de desenvolvimento e teste, avisos de Mudanças de Engenharia e procedimentos de fabricação;
  • Oferecer suporte aos engenheiros em tópicos relacionados a software/firmware para certificação técnica americana UL (Underwriters Laboratories) UL60730 e UL858;
  • Participar da revisão do projeto de hardware e trabalha com engenheiros de hardware para fornecer soluções alternativas;
  • Fornecer suporte e treinamento sobre novos produtos para outros departamentos e clientes, conforme necessário;
  • Estimar a duração das tarefas e auxiliar na preparação do projeto;

REQUISITOS

  • Conhecimento avançado em programação C em sistemas embarcados baseados em microcontroladores.
  • Experiência relevante comprovada no desenvolvimento de firmware embarcado, preferencialmente em ambiente de P&D de produtos para linha branca;
  • Experiência na programação de firmware C para sistemas embarcados;
  • Experiência no design de hardware;
  • Capacidade para gerar especificações de software a partir das especificações do produto;
  • Domínio da programação e configuração dos Pinos;
  • Proficiência em um dos controladores Renesas, Freescale ou ST e familiarizado com o ambiente/ferramentas de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com IAR é um diferencial;
  • Capacidade de testar/depurar firmware com osciloscópio, depuradores, emuladores e analisadores lógicos;
  • Histórico comprovado em suporte a todos os aspectos de uma organização de fabricação de eletrônicos para atingir as taxas de produção exigidas.
  • Experiência com requisitos de agências e normas, preferencialmente (IEC/UL60730, normas, especialmente aquelas relacionadas a produtos de linha branca);
  • Sólido conhecimento em processos de fabricação de eletrônicos;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em integração de sistemas e nas interações entre design de hardware e software.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Disposição para seguir as orientações da equipe em arquitetura de software e outros processos de desenvolvimento. Capacidade de aprimorar processos é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de software modular;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com testes de caixa branca, análise estática de código e software classe B de segurança IEC/UL60730;
  • Experiência com controle de versão, rastreamento de problemas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos ( Git , Jira , PTC);
  • Experiência com tecnologia de toque capacitivo;
  • Capacidade de interpretar esquemas. Conhecimento em projeto de hardware.

IDIOMAS

Inglês avançado mandatório .

PERFIL

  • Capaz de trabalhar como membro integral e colaborador de equipes nacionais e internacionais de desenvolvimento técnico de eletrônicos;
  • Capaz de trabalhar com eficácia dentro de restrições de tempo, prioridades variáveis e de forma independente;
  • Capaz de organizar e gerenciar a carga de trabalho para dar suporte eficaz a múltiplos projetos.
  • Com excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escritas quanto orais.

CARGO: Analista de Desenvolvimento do Produto.

HORÁRIO DE TRABALHO

Segunda à sexta das 08:00 às 17:30.

REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT por tempo indeterminado;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Antom & Ant International

Our vision is to provide inclusive and convenient payment and financial solutions for global cross-border consumers and sellers. As part of Ant international product team , you will play a pivotal role in achieving our global vision. We are looking for a dynamic Product Manager to take ownership of enabling extensive payment methods in Brazil for global merchants and delivering superior acquiring solutions to Brazil-based businesses.

The Role

In this position, you will be responsible for ensuring an optimal user experience, higher approval rates, operational efficiency, and strict adherence to security and regulatory standards. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, driving the evolution of our payment ecosystem in Latin America.

Key Responsibilities

  • User & Market Insights: Understand user behavior and mindset through deep-dive research, data mining, observation, and E2E testing.
  • Channel Expansion: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to expand Brazilian payment channels for global merchants.
  • Integration Management: Lead the E2E transaction flow and manage the integration of payment channels onto the Alipay platform , from contract review to go-live.
  • Merchant Solutions: Identify payment pain points for Brazil-based merchants; propose and implement innovative solutions to solve them.
  • Product Excellence: Strengthen foundational product elements, including payment processing, settlement, and merchant services, to enhance competitiveness and user satisfaction.
  • Competitive Analysis: Monitor the Latin American competitive landscape and emerging trends to identify untapped opportunities and unmet needs.
  • Performance Tracking: Define and track key product performance metrics, continuously iterating to improve customer experience.
  • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary product contact and advocate, both internally and externally.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in payment products, with a strong focus on Pix and card payment processing .
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of digital wallets, payment technology, and the Latam fintech ecosystem.
  • Product Design: Proven track record in E2E payment product design and implementation is highly preferred.
  • Technical Savvy: Hands-on experience working with both business and technical teams, translating requirements into clear product specifications.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven decision-making skills and ability to perform competitor analysis and strategic planning.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrix environment that requires high cross-functional collaboration.
  • Global Mindset: Comfortable working across different time zones.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is required.

How to Apply

If you are passionate about the future of global payments and want to make an impact in the Latam market, we want to hear from you!

title: SAP S/4HANA Security & Authorisation Manager
description:
SAP S/4HANA Security and Authorisation Manager | Digital Core

Locations: Sao Paolo, Brazil - Hyderabad, India

As we work to transform and optimise Mars, a new program has been mobilised by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonisation scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program focuses primarily on eight mega process areas: Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfil (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (sales order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This transformation requires thought leadership, quality decision making, deep technical know-how, and an ability to navigate complex business challenges while applying a holistic and multi-disciplinary approach to each of these mega processes.

As part of the program, four new positions have been created to manage all core Security and Compliance activities related to the SAP S/4HANA landscape.

Collectively the new roles will be responsible for the delivery of the core SAP Security deliverables within S/4HANA and FIORI ensuring alignment with role design, processes and governance principles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. personally and within the team.
  • Support the SAP Security team in ensuring that shared and local / segment template security requirements are adopted across business segments while incorporating segment-specific needs into the shared template or localising them as necessary.
  • Analyse and understand the security requirements and risks of a complex ERP environment that underpins critical business and IT processes.
  • Work with the SAP Security team and Global Process Owners (GPO’s) in implementing a comprehensive SAP Security and GRC framework, including strategies, policies, and procedures that align with organisational objectives and industry best practices to ensure robust access controls, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and deliver technical and functional solutions against specifications in accordance with agreed standards and procedures.
  • Follow standards and procedure for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and segregation of duties.
  • Lead and support multiple testing phases – including build unit tests (BUT) security unit tests (SUT) system integration tests (SIT) and user acceptance tests (UAT) by leveraging Mars current test tools to ensure robust SAP security and system integrity.
  • Collaborate effectively within a diverse team that fosters an inclusive culture, ensuring all contributions are valued and recognised.
  • Stay informed on emerging security threats and apply industry best practices to strengthen SAP application security and controls.

Context and Scope

Programs are often marked by a seamless transition from the old system/landscape to the new one. As part of this SAP S/4HANA Digital Transformation program, we require someone with high-level expertise and experience in SAP Security & Authorisations in S/4HANA including FIORI.

The successful candidate will support the delivery of the security scope and collaborate with counterparts at Mars (i.e. Petcare, Corporate, Snacking and Food) to capture and analyse authorisation requirements and security related activities.

Education and Professional

  • 10+ years in SAP Security and Authorisations with at least three full life cycle implementations in S/4HANA and FIORI.
  • Professional certification such as SAP Certified Technology Professional, SAP Access Control 12.0, or other relevant security certifications.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA security and authorisations including role design administration and integration with FIORI.
  • Proficiency in security design, configuration, testing and deployment across key technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori and SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).
  • Strong understanding of authorisation concepts for S/4 HANA including FIORI, Business Technology Platform (BTP) and other Cloud applications such SuccessFactors, Ariba, & SAP MDG.
  • Deep knowledge of SOX compliance, segregation of duties (SoD), GDPR, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent understanding of S/4HANA product roadmap.
  • Highly organised with proven experience in setting and managing deadlines across diverse stakeholder groups while ensuring clear ownership and accountability for all activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong team player mindset with a drive to develop new professional skills combined with proactive, growth oriented and goal-focused approach to work.
  • Excellent documentation, visualisation and presentation skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft office tools particularly PowerPoint and Excel with expertise in building complex formulas, developing pivot tables and creating data-driven reports and presentations.
  • Experience working with System and Business Integrators.
  • Ability to work under pressure and maintain a professional manner.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Digital Marketing Manager - Performance and Growth
description:
Pluxee is a global player in Employee Benefits and Engagement that operates in 28 countries. Pluxee helps companies attract, engage, and retain talent thanks to a broad range of solutions across Meal & Food, Well-‏being, Lifestyle, Reward & Recognition, and Public Benefits. Powered by leading technology and more than 5,600 engaged team members, Pluxee acts as a trusted partner within a highly interconnected B2B2C ecosystem made up of more than 500,000 clients, 37 million+ consumers, and 1.7 million+ merchants. Conducting business for more than 45 years, Pluxee is committed to creating a positive impact on local communities, supporting well-‏being at work for employees, and protecting the planet.

Your next challenge

We are looking for a Performance Growth Digital Marketing Manager to accelerate Pluxee’s acquisition, conversion, and revenue growth in LATAM South . You will lead a multicultural team of 7 performance specialists across Brazil, Peru, Chile, and Uruguay , driving multi-country digital strategies while ensuring local excellence, that includes SEO/GEO, Paid Media and Marketing Automation.

This role is ideal for a hands-on, data-driven leader passionate about scaling performance engines in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

The Performance Growth Digital Marketing Manager manages Pluxee’s multi‑country growth engine across Brazil, Peru, Chile, and Uruguay, leading a multi-cultural team of 8 specialists focused on Paid Media, SEO/Geo, Marketing Automation, and Performance Analytics. The role drives end‑to‑end acquisition and retention strategies for B2B, B2M, and B2C audiences, ensuring regional consistency while adapting to local needs.

The job includes overseeing campaign execution, optimization, experimentation, and conversion improvements, using data to steer decisions and maximize ROI. Collaborating closely with CRM, Product, Content, Sales, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated growth outcomes. As a regional leader, enable operational excellence, elevate digital maturity, and accelerate business growth through a strong performance marketing framework.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Lead & Develop a High-Performing Multi-Country Team

  • Manage, mentor, and upskill an 8-person performance marketing team distributed across 4 countries.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

title: QA Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em uma empresa do segmento de Agronegócio , que está estruturando uma nova área de tecnologia, com forte foco em SAP S/4HANA , processos críticos de negócio e transformação digital.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Apoiar na estruturação da área de QA, ajudando a definir processos, padrões e boas práticas
  • Executar testes manuais e apoiar na evolução de automações
  • Validar fluxos de negócio (originação de grãos, logística e financeiro) garantindo qualidade das entregas
  • Atuar em testes funcionais, integrados (SIT) e de aceitação (UAT)
  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar bugs
  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar na organização de evidências e documentação de testes

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com processos de QA (planejamento, execução e gestão de bugs)
  • Vivência com testes manuais e automatizados, com contato em automação de testes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex.: Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, CBTA ou similares)
  • Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Newman, Rest Assured, Swagger ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de teste (SIT, UAT e Regressão)
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de testes (Jira, SAP Cloud ALM, Azure DevOps ou similares)

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com automação utilizando Python (Pytest, Robot Framework).
  • Familiaridade com uso de IA no desenvolvimento de testes (GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
  • Conhecimento em módulos SAP (ACM, SD, MM, FI, TM).
  • Vivência com metodologia SAP Activate.
  • Experiência no setor de Agronegócio ou Logística Multimodal será considerada um diferencial.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
About us

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.

We are seeking a strategic User Acquisition expert to drive performance-led growth across our mobile ecosystem in LATAM. This role owns the end-to-end paid acquisition strategy, from planning and executing campaigns across major ad networks to scaling what works through rigorous experimentation and optimization. Leveraging deep expertise in mobile attribution, creative testing, and growth channels, you will play a critical role in accelerating sustainable user growth as we continue building our super app across multiple markets.

Please submit your resume in English. Otherwise, your application will be dismissed.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute user acquisition strategies across major paid channels (Google, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, etc.).
  • Manage and optimize large advertising budgets to maximize ROI and maintain strong CAC performance.
  • Partner closely with analytics, product, and creative teams to improve funnel performance and post-install metrics.
  • Own and scale creative testing pipelines, expanding top-performing assets while ensuring brand consistency.
  • Evaluate and pilot new user acquisition channels, technologies, and measurement frameworks to improve efficiency and scale.
  • Lead and scale digital growth initiatives across multiple user acquisition channels and markets.
  • Build, manage, and optimize performance marketing campaigns to drive sustainable, data-driven user growth.
  • Own large paid media budgets, ensuring strong ROI and CAC through continuous experimentation and optimization.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in user acquisition or performance marketing, preferably for mobile products.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Deep understanding of MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular) and attribution models (CTIT, re-attribution, SRNs, etc.).
  • Proven experience managing large paid budgets and optimizing campaigns toward ROI/CAC goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build hypotheses, run experiments, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  • Solid understanding of creative testing, audience segmentation, and conversion rate optimization.

We offer:

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Work Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Report To : JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader

Business Type : Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & Sales

I. Business Introduction

JD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil , focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.

  • Core Positioning : Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products.
  • Core Advantages : Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil , and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications .
  • Business Scope : Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts , supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement , and realizing fast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.

II. Key Job Responsibilities

1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)

  • In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool.
  • Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail).
  • Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.

2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management

  • Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover.
  • Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.

3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output

  • Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management.
  • Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery.
  • Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.

4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management

  • Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety.
  • Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.

5. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant.
  • Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.

III. Job Requirements

1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)

  • Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil : Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.).
  • MRO Procurement Professional Ability : 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes.
  • In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market : Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.

2. Professional Skills

  • Business Negotiation : Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management.
  • Cost and Data Analysis : Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data.
  • Language Ability : Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English; fluent in Chinese is preferred.
  • Office Tools : Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.

3. Comprehensive Quality

  • Business Thinking : Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management.
  • Customer Orientation : Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance.
  • Pressure Resistance and Execution : Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation.
  • Compliance and Integrity : Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.

4. Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above , major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred.
  • 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America; experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.

IV. What We Offer

  • International Platform : JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters.
  • Salary and Benefits : Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies.
  • Development Space : Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader.
  • Localization Support : Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

description:

title: Consultor SAP HCM TM
description:
Join us on a journey of endless possibilities

At Strada, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.

With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.

Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver people-first solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.

Learn more at

About the Role

Strada is looking for a highly skilled Senior SAP Time Consultant with solid experience in SAP Time Management implementation and support. The ideal candidate will lead time-related functional workstreams, provide expert-level guidance to clients, and deliver high‑quality solutions aligned with HR and Payroll processes.

This role requires strong analytical skills, the ability to work closely with global teams (particularly in Europe), and proven experience delivering AMS and project services in complex environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the analysis, design, configuration, and implementation of SAP Time Management (PT) solutions, including schemas, rules, and work schedules.
  • Provide expert support for Time Evaluation , Absence/Attendance Management , Shift Planning , and Interfaces with Payroll .
  • Conduct requirement-gathering workshops with global stakeholders and convert business needs into functional specifications.
  • Perform enhancements, testing (unit, regression, integration), and documentation according to Strada's delivery standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex time evaluation issues and propose optimized solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across SAP HCM, SuccessFactors, and Payroll.
  • Support AMS operations by handling incidents, service requests, and minor enhancements with SLA compliance.
  • Train users and junior consultants; provide guidance on best practices and process improvements.
  • Ensure alignment with Strada’s governance model, delivery framework, and quality methodologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, HR Information Systems, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in SAP Time Management consulting.
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Time Evaluation schemas and PCRs
  • Absence/Attendance configuration
  • Work schedules, public holidays, and time quotas
  • Integrations with Payroll (SAP HCM or EC Payroll)
  • Experience working in international/multicultural delivery teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Poruguese and English languages are a must to have.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SuccessFactors Employee Central Time Off or Workforce Software is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of AMS delivery models (ITIL, incident lifecycle management).
  • SAP certification in HCM Time Management is a plus.
  • Experience supporting European time schemas (Spain, Italy, France, UK, etc.) is highly desirable.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with global clients across Europe and the Americas.
  • Flexible work model with team collaboration across time zones.
  • Professional growth within a high-performing SAP and Cloud consulting environment.
  • Competitive compensation and clear career development path.

At Strada, our values guide everything we do:

  • Anticipate Customer Needs – We stay ahead of trends so our customers can grow and succeed.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility for delivering excellence and ensuring things get done right.
  • Challenge Ourselves to Work Smarter – We move faster than the world around us to drive change and accomplish more.
  • Empower Each Other to Solve Problems – We tackle challenges head on, ask tough questions, and collaborate to find the best solutions.
  • Care About Our Work and Our People – We understand that what we do impacts millions, and we have a responsibility to get it right.

Benefits

At Strada, we support your whole self—offering a range of benefits for your health, wellbeing, finances, and future. These include health coverage, wellbeing programs, paid leave (vacation, sick, parental), retirement plans, learning opportunities, and more.

All offers are contingent on successful completion of background checks, where permitted by law and as appropriate for the role. These may include identity, education, employment, and in some cases, criminal history verification, checks against global watchlists, credit reports, and/or drug testing. You’ll be informed of the specific checks applicable to your role and location during the recruitment process.

Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Strada is dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We believe that embracing differences strengthens our teams and drives innovation and success.

Diversity Policy Statement

Strada is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination based on legally protected characteristics. We actively support the advancement of underrepresented groups and provide reasonable accommodations for disabilities and religious practices. Applicants may request a reasonable accommodation by contacting their recruiter.

Authorization to work in the Employing Country

To be considered, you must have current and future work authorization in the country where you're applying, without the need for visa sponsorship by Strada.

Please note: This job description does not limit Strada’s right to assign or reassign responsibilities, including to subsidiaries, partners, or future business purchasers.
