title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema

Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.

Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.

In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.

Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.

What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Pre-Sales Consultant - Physical AI - Brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.

• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (LiDAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-DoF pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2Sim asset creation).

• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.

• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.

• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.

• Experience with at least two of: LiDAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3D reconstruction, or simulation environments.

• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.

• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.

• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).

• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.

• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.

What We Offer

• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.

• Competitive base salary.

• Comprehensive benefits package.

• Flexible remote-first culture.

**At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. Please send us your complete resume in English.

title: Growth Analyst | Internship
description:
O que a Liora faz

O Brasil tem um mercado de energia elétrica de R$ 300 bilhões por ano. A maioria das pessoas paga a conta todo mês sem questionar o valor, sem entender as opções e sem receber nada em troca além do serviço básico. A Liora muda essa equação.

A gente transforma a conta de luz em um produto financeiro — com cashback real, acesso a crédito e uma experiência que faz sentido para quem usa. O cliente economiza, a gente cresce, e o dinheiro que antes ficava parado numa conta de concessionária começa a circular de volta pra vida das pessoas.

Não é uma ideia. Em três meses de 2026 já dobramos de tamanho. A projeção é crescer 15x até dezembro. Temos backing de Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital — fundos que apostam em empresas com potencial de redefinir mercados inteiros. Se você quer entender como uma empresa assim é construída por dentro, essa vaga é o caminho mais curto.

Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, muito regulado e historicamente resistente à mudança. Isso significa que a maioria dos brasileiros ainda não sabe que pode escolher de onde vem sua energia — e os que sabem, muitas vezes não confiam em quem oferece.

Escalar num mercado assim exige mais do que anúncio bem feito — exige entender o que faz uma pessoa confiar, decidir e agir. Quem entrar nessa vaga vai trabalhar exatamente nisso: entender o que quebra a resistência do cliente, o que gera conversão de verdade e como transformar esse aprendizado num processo que escala.

Meta/Google Ads, Metabase, SQL, Python, N8N e Sheets são apenas ferramentas. O trabalho real é entender por que algo funciona — e saber replicar isso em escala sem perder a eficiência.

Por que essa vaga é diferente

A maioria das vagas "de marketing" te coloca pra promover posts, reportar métricas e esperar aprovação de três camadas hierárquicas. Essa não.

Você vai sentar do lado de quem toma decisão desde o primeiro mês. Vai ter acesso aos números reais da empresa — CAC, LTV, taxa de conversão por canal, por criativo, por oferta. Vai propor experimentos, defender sua lógica e ver o resultado aparecer em tempo real. É o tipo de exposição que a maioria das pessoas leva anos pra conseguir. Aqui você tem isso desde o começo.

Perfil que buscamos

Você não precisa ter experiência em marketing, em energia ou em nenhuma área específica. Você precisa:

  • Gostar de números de verdade — não só de ler dashboard, mas de questionar o que está por trás dele.
  • Conseguir pegar um problema confuso e quebrar em partes que podem ser testadas
  • Ter mais curiosidade do que certeza, e mais disposição pra errar rápido do que medo de estar errado
  • Ser ambicioso no sentido real da palavra — alguém que pensa em construir algo grande, não só em ter um emprego que paga bem

Se você está na faculdade, querendo mais do que aula teórica, e quer entender como uma empresa de verdade cresce na prática — essa vaga é pra você!

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact; transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .

With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films; it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.

On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!

What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As our Marketing Specialist, you will lead the development and execution of growth strategies that position Peliplat as a must-try platform for film lovers.

You will create campaigns that spark curiosity, drive engagement, and fuel viral growth—leveraging influencers, community dynamics, and storytelling to scale our global presence.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute growth strategies to drive installs, engagement, and retention
  • Identify and scale viral loops, referral systems, and community-driven growth mechanisms
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Content teams to align growth initiatives

Campaign Development

  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution (e.g., “Watch With (Name),” themed screenings, launch campaigns)
  • Translate product features and content into compelling, user-facing narratives
  • Build campaigns that drive both immediate traction and long-term brand equity

Influencer & Partnership Strategy

  • Collaborate with influencers, creators, and partners to expand reach and credibility
  • Design and execute influencer programs and activation strategies
  • Identify high-potential creators and turn them into growth drivers for the platform

Performance & Optimization

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across key metrics (acquisition, engagement, retention)
  • Continuously test, iterate, and optimize campaigns based on data and insights

Who You Are

  • A builder mindset: you don’t just plan, you execute, test, and scale
  • Strong creative instinct paired with data-driven decision making
  • Deep interest in entertainment, culture, and digital communities
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and results-oriented

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in marketing, growth, or brand strategy
  • Proven track record of driving user acquisition and campaign performance
  • Experience in LATAM markets is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical, communication, and execution skills

Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder
  • Strategic Hustle — Create Value Beyond Budget
  • Problem-Solving — Decode Complexity
  • Result Oriented — Drive Real Impact
  • Market Intelligence — Know the Game
  • Passion for Cinema & Community — Build What You Believe In

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.
  • Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there.
  • High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally.
  • Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required.
  • Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with project management or CRM tools.
  • Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients.
  • Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Reports to the Director of Accounts
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Desenvolvedor de software em teste
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end mobile test automation frameworks using Selenium and Playwright
  • Define the overall QA strategy including unit, integration, regression, and performance testing
  • Establish test coverage standards and drive adoption across the Android and iOS workstreams
  • Collaborate with the Tech Lead, Android, and iOS developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD
  • Create, manage, and groom JIRA test-related user stories, defects, and test cycles
  • Lead exploratory and regression testing for major releases
  • Mentor and guide Mid SDETs in automation best practices and framework usage
  • Produce and maintain test reports, dashboards, and quality metrics
  • Identify and escalate risks and quality issues to the Tech Lead and project stakeholders
  • Champion a shift-left testing culture within the engineering team

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of SDET or QA Automation Engineer experience
  • Expert proficiency with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript for test scripting
  • Experience with mobile test automation for Android (Espresso, UIAutomator) and iOS (XCUITest)
  • Proficiency with Appium for cross-platform mobile automation
  • Deep experience managing test cases, defects, and cycles in JIRA (Zephyr or Xray preferred)
  • Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitrise)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum QA processes
  • Expert-level understanding and advocacy of Test Driven Development (TDD) and its application within QA and development workflows
  • Excellent analytical and root cause analysis skills
  • Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
  • Familiarity with mobile performance testing tools (Firebase Test Lab, AWS Device Farm)
  • Knowledge of API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured)
  • Background in accessibility testing for mobile applications

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.

Tempo indeterminado.

description:

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA

ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.

About the Job

ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.

This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development

  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.

Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution

  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.

Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management

  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.

Project Oversight & Value Realization

  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.

What You’ll Need

Experience

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.

Network & Market Knowledge

  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.

Territory Management

  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.

Languages

  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.

Commercial & Strategic Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.

Remote Collaboration

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.

Travel

  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Why Join us?

  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.

*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

title: User Operations Expert
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a User Operations Expert – User Growth to join our Growth team in São Paulo. This role will be responsible for driving end-to-end customer growth strategy , focusing on user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention .

You will play a critical role in building a scalable and sustainable user growth engine , combining data insights, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to unlock new growth opportunities and maximize user lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

1. User Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Design and execute customer growth strategies across the full funnel (acquisition → activation → retention → loyalty)
  • Develop a structured growth framework based on user lifecycle and behavioral insights
  • Build and continuously optimize a sustainable growth engine aligned with business goals

2. User Segmentation & Retention Strategy

  • Develop and manage a robust user segmentation model (e.g., new, active, dormant, high-value users)
  • Design targeted engagement and retention initiatives to increase stickiness and frequency
  • Drive lifecycle marketing strategies to improve user contribution, loyalty, and long-term value

3. Channel Expansion & Acquisition Optimization

  • Identify and test new user acquisition channels (organic, paid, partnerships, referrals, etc.)
  • Optimize channel performance through continuous experimentation and A/B testing
  • Stay ahead of emerging traffic trends and growth tactics to reach high-quality users

4. Data Analysis & Product Collaboration

  • Analyze user behavior data to identify growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Translate insights into actionable growth initiatives and experiments
  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to enhance user experience and product features that drive growth

5. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Data, and Tech teams to align priorities and resources
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to ensure efficient execution of growth projects
  • Act as a key stakeholder in growth-related decision-making and roadmap planning

Requirements

  • Proven experience in User Growth, User Operations, Growth Marketing, or similar roles (preferably in B2C / marketplace / tech environments)
  • Strong understanding of growth frameworks (AARRR, lifecycle management, retention loops)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale user growth strategies from data insights
  • Advanced analytical skills ( SQL or strong data analysis capability is a plus )
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

title: QA Engineer
description:
As the leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world. We are continuing to grow and are looking for an QA Automation Engineer.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Automate test procedures and cases using approved software tools, following our internal QA Automation standards.
  • Participate in Code-Review process.
  • Design and execute SQL statements for database manipulation and querying.
  • Communicate results of software testing efforts to management through the creation of test summaries and logs.

  • Monitor status of software bugs found and ensure they are resolved by software engineers.
  • Any other tasks required by management.
  • Perform various types of testing including black box, white box, integration, functional, systems, sanity, smoke, regression, acceptance, stress, load, performance, usability, installation, recovery, security, compatibility, and more on software systems.
  • Analyze the test basis for test conditions.
  • Conduct verbal discussions with stakeholders, analyze programming source code, and utilize any other methods necessary to find additional test conditions.
  • Prioritize test conditions to ensure that those having the highest impact on the system are tested first.
  • Create and modify written test procedures, test cases, test logs, and other test-related documentation using approved software tools.
  • Manually execute test procedures and cases.

Skills Required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio (.NET/C#) or Java. JavaScript and HTML as well as SQL Server experience are preferred as well.
  • Experience with docker and microservice applications.
  • Solid Object-Oriented Programming paradigm understanding and experience.
  • Experience with web applications and multiple web browsers (such as IE, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.)
  • BS degree in Computer Science or Engineering or Software Testing required.
  • Excellent research, analytical, and organization skills with an exceptional eye for detail
  • Experience with and/or passion for both code and product excellence. You care about the quality of software your company’s software.
  • Excellent English writing skills is essential to creating useful and consistent test documentation that can be utilized by
  • Proficient English verbal communication skills
  • Experience working with at least one bug-tracking tool such as Team Foundation Server, JIRA, etc.
  • Ability to quickly and independently learn about new technologies, business and technical terms and concepts is essential.
  • Ability to perform software testing activities on a wide variety of complex software applications and systems, platforms and devices that utilize various technologies.
  • Reviewing programming code in various programming languages is essential to performing white box testing.
  • Ability to collaborate with multiple departments and teams, demonstrating high-quality interpersonal skills, including good listening skills, respectful treatment of others, and professional behavior.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and individually with a self-starter ("can do") attitude.
  • Ability to perform testing activities according to set priorities and delivery time lines
  • Ability to take constructive criticism.
  • Ability to perform testing activities for multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with Agile as it relates to software testing is an asset.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • One (1) year of demonstrated prior work experience conducting the primary responsibilities outlined in this job description.
  • One (1) year experience Software Testing with Automation
  • Experience working with at least one automated test development tool such as Ranorex, Selenium, TestComplete, QTP, etc.

Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Você atuará como uma referência funcional em SAP dentro do time de TI, combinando visão de arquitetura funcional com atuação prática na sustentação e gestão de demandas.   • Gerenciar a fila de chamados do contrato de AMS, priorizando, acompanhando e garantindo o andamento das solicitações.

  • Atuar com visão sistêmica, conectando diferentes módulos e impactos no negócio.

  • Conhecimento geral em SAP, com atuação em múltiplos módulos e visão integrada dos processos;
  • Experiência em análise funcional, com capacidade de entender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em soluções sistêmicas;
  • Vivência com arquitetura funcional, avaliando impactos, integrações e consistência das soluções;

  • Boa comunicação para interação com usuários, times técnicos e fornecedores;
  • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com gestão de perfis de acesso e segurança em SAP (GRC);
  • Possuir vivência mais aprofundada em governança de AMS e relacionamento com fornecedores;
  • Tiver visão estratégica de sustentação, indo além da operação e propondo melhorias.

title: Devops (Foco em Testes de Infraestrutura)
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente, uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.

Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de seguros, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Devops (foco em testes de Infraestrutura) para construir testes end-to-end abrangentes para nossa infraestrutura em AWS e fluxos de CI/CD. O foco do profissional para essa posição será dedicado ao desenho e implementação de automação de testes para a stack de infraestrutura, e não à gestão de sistemas em produção.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar testes end-to-end para fluxos de infraestrutura em múltiplas camadas (Terraform → Helm → CI/CD → Deploy de aplicações)
  • Construir automação de testes para pipelines de CI/CD no GitLab e para deploys de Helm Charts
  • Desenvolver infraestrutura de testes utilizando frameworks como Chainsaw para validação de Kubernetes/Helm
  • Criar frameworks de testes para prevenir infrastructure drift e identificar problemas de deploy antes que cheguem à produção
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time na definição de estratégias de teste para componentes complexos de infraestrutura

Experiências esperadas

  • Experiência em infraestrutura/DevOps, com forte foco em automação de testes
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de teste de infraestrutura (Chainsaw, Terratest, Kitchen-Terraform ou similares)
  • Capacidade de projetar estratégias de teste para sistemas complexos e multicamadas (não apenas testes unitários)
  • Experiência em testar os próprios pipelines de CI/CD (validando a lógica dos pipelines, e não apenas seu uso)
  • Experiência em produção com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AWS EKS) e entendimento de como testar configurações de cluster
  • Forte habilidade em programação voltada à automação de testes (Python, Node.js/TypeScript ou similares)
  • Experiência com Terraform e Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experiência com AWS (EKS, RDS, S3 e serviços relacionados)

Diferenciais

title: Embedded Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. title: Pharmaceutical Field Specialist
description:
Job title: Field Specialist, Brazil

Job Type: Project-related part-time work (working hours depend on availability, but if you are working on a project, we ask for 1-3 days per week).

Are you looking for something flexible? Do you have sales, marketing or market research experience within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries? Are you interested in joining a fast-paced and growing global organisation?

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a Field Specialist to join our Brazil team. This role will shadow pharmaceutical representatives for the day and prepare a report based on observations made while working with the representative as they interact with their customers. The position is appointment based, depending on the size of the project and number of field days required. The position would be suitable for someone looking for project-related part-time work that leads to a long-term collaboration.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Contacting sales representatives to arrange a shadowing day in the field
  • Observing interactions between sales representatives and customers without disrupting their day (primarily face to face)
  • Conducting a 60–90-minute interview with the sales representative during the field day
  • Submitting structured reports (workbooks), translated into English, after each day in the field based on observations made within 24-48 hours of field visit
  • Attending a 30-60 min online session prior to each project to understand the project objectives and share feedback
  • Participate in project debrief calls and potentially provide feedback to assist in the development of final recommendations

Person Specification:

  • Experience in sales, marketing or market research within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries
  • Fluent command of Portuguese and English (written and oral)
  • Bachelor’s degree – marketing, science, or data focus is preferred
  • When working on a project, have 1-3 days availability during the week
  • Flexibility to work from morning to evening
  • Flexibility to travel within the country
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listener
  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel

Opportunity:

  • Work with a successful and well-established company with an enviable growth trajectory
  • Working with 29 out of top 30 pharmaceutical companies globally
  • Great flexibility in managing the workload and opportunity to travel within the country
  • Structured and on-going training system and working with strong management team

If you would like to apply for this position, please submit your CV in ENGLISH .

About STEM:

STEM Healthcare is a dynamic, fast paced global pharmaceutical and life science, commercial benchmarking firm headquartered in the UK and present across six continents. STEM have developed an audit process and built a benchmarking database with more than 500,000 face-to-face observations completed across 52 countries. The benchmark provided is unique in the pharmaceutical industry consisting of over 100 KPIs, while focusing on 2-3 key priorities during formulation of action planning in order to help clients further accelerate performance.

STEM accelerates performance, improves strategic alignment, and facilitates excellence in marketing, medical, market access and account plans strategy execution. Due to the unique, specialised and highly targeted offering, STEM is experiencing a rapid growth phase, and recruiting heavily across the world. New employees will be joining at a time where rapid career development and growth opportunities are expected, as the organisation works towards their mid and long-term goals.

Vision: To always be viewed as an essential partner in enabling our clients to reach more patients with their medicines

Mission: To accelerate high performance

Core Values: Brave, Honest, Performance Driven, Practical, Customer Focused, Caring

Find us here:

Website:

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing

  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.

Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.

The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.

This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.

Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.

Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .

Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Technical Expert
description:
At Etex, our purpose is to inspire new ways of living. We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority. We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.

At Etex, we seek to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our customers and our communities. Are you looking for a company where you can learn, grow and lead? Join us as an Technical Expert for Brazil, based in Río de Janeiro!

The mission of the role is act as the key technical interface in large-scale industrial projects across South America, ensuring equipment specifications, installation, and performance meet Etex standards and international norms. The role safeguards project delivery in terms of safety, timing, and budget, while supporting project managers and coordinating with suppliers, local teams, and stakeholders.

What you’ll do

  • Develop technical specifications for equipment purchases and installations, aligned with Etex standards and customer requirements.
  • Review and align supplier proposals with international and group standards.
  • Monitor the full project lifecycle: engineering studies, manufacturing, acceptance tests, commissioning, start-up, and closure.
  • Supervise erection works on-site, ensuring safety and timely execution.
  • Provide recommendations to stakeholders to support decision-making.
  • Act as the interface between suppliers, local customers, operational teams, and project managers.
  • Support project managers with PMO methodology and reporting.
  • Manage budget responsibilities depending on project size.
  • Communicate effectively with multicultural teams and suppliers, maintaining leadership and authority.

What you’ll bring

  • Engineering degree or confirmed technician background in mechanics or electricity/automation; knowledge of construction/civil works is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in technical fields, with appetite for managing large technical projects.
  • Strong technical expertise in mechanics/electricity; proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
  • Language skills: fluent English mandatory.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to challenge suppliers constructively.
  • Flexibility, resilience, and autonomy under remote management (Europe-based).
  • Ability to work collaboratively, avoiding silo mentality.

Why join us?

  • We are named the world's #1 most trustworthy company in the construction sector by Newsweek and Statista in 2023!
  • Our culture – we connect & care about those around us. We nurture teamwork, communities, partnerships and new ways of working, placing the highest importance on the safety and working environment of our people.
  • Our ‘Road to Sustainability 2030’ is our plan to help build a better, sustainable future. We work towards this vision by caring about our social and environmental impacts and developing innovative solutions
  • We have a strong conviction that diversity of thinking helps us to deliver a strong and sustainable performance. It is also essential for us that everyone feels part of the team. In this spirit, we are committed to equal opportunities and zero tolerance towards discrimination
  • Flexibility: For us, hybrid and flexible working is all about trust, and we want you to be able to do your best work (depending on the role).

A função também envolve a gestão de contas oficiais da marca e o desenvolvimento de parcerias com outras indústrias, ampliando a presença e o alcance da marca.

Essa é uma posição hands-on, ideal para alguém que combine visão estratégica com forte capacidade de execução, e que tenha experiência com marketing de performance e iniciativas de crescimento em um ambiente digital dinâmico.

Necessário inglês avançado ou fluente para interação com o time global.

Contrato Presencial em Recife/PE.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias gerais de aquisição de novos usuários, incluindo planos por canal, estratégias de marca, parcerias com KOLs/influenciadores, planejamento de orçamento e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Compreender o perfil dos influenciadores e das principais audiências nas redes sociais no mercado brasileiro, impulsionando colaborações com KOLs alinhadas à marca BingoPlus, gerando tráfego e visibilidade por meio de conteúdo.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em marketing de afiliados no mercado brasileiro, sendo responsável pela criação, gestão e relacionamento com parceiros afiliados.
  • Atuar em iniciativas de mídia paga, colaborando com o time global de tráfego da Digiplus para implementar estratégias localizadas de aquisição de usuários e contribuir com recomendações estratégicas.
  • Contribuir com ideias e estratégias para a gestão das redes sociais oficiais, criando conteúdos atrativos e estruturando um modelo consistente de operação dos canais.
  • Planejar e executar colaborações com outras indústrias de forma criativa e proativa, ampliando o alcance e posicionamento da marca.
  • Executar a estratégia de marketing alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de marketing em canais online e offline.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das campanhas, garantindo eficiência e melhoria contínua de ROI.
  • Apoiar na gestão do orçamento de marketing, sugerindo alocações eficientes entre canais.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento do usuário e ações da concorrência.

title: Latam Marketing Manager
description:
BSI’s Assurance division is hiring a LATAM Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy across Latin America with a primary focus on Mexico.

In this role, you will translate global strategy into high-impact, localized programs that fuel pipeline and revenue across System Certification, Training, and ISA, while leading our regional Center of Excellence (CoE) for campaign development, design, and digital execution.

You’ll also serve regionally as a Theme Lead for Quality & Mobility, setting the bar for messaging and integrated campaigns used across the Americas.

If you thrive in a matrixed, fast-paced environment and can flex from strategy to hands-on execution, this role is for you!

What you’ll own:

  • LatAm GTM leadership: Build and deliver the marketing plan for Latin America (with Mexico emphasis) aligned to commercial targets and sector priorities.
  • Localization that wins: Adapt global/regional campaigns to local language, culture, regulation, and buyer behavior.
  • Partner with the business: Collaborate effectively with Sales and Training to shape marketing strategies that move pipeline and revenue.

How you’ll lead:

  • Operational excellence: Drive clarity, workload management, and accountability using project tools (e.g., Workfront); uphold brand, compliance, and governance standards.

How you’ll execute:

  • Full-funnel, integrated campaigns: Orchestrate email, web, SEO/SEM, paid media, social, events/webinars, and ABM to create demand and accelerate conversions.
  • Digital & demand-gen mastery: Increase engagement, improve targeting, and optimize journeys; manage lead workflows in Salesforce and Pardot (segmentation, routing, nurture).
  • Budget ownership: Plan, allocate, and track the LATAM marketing budget for maximum ROI.
  • Vendor leadership: Manage local partners (design, translation, event logistics, media buying) to deliver on brief, on brand, on budget.
  • Brand & governance: Ensure every asset meets BSI’s standards and regional regulatory requirements.

How you’ll measure success:

  • Performance & analytics: Track KPIs and attribution, maintain CRM hygiene, and partner with data teams on ROI reporting.
  • Optimize in real time: Use funnel insights to test, learn, and iterate maximizing conversion and marketing-influenced revenue.

Regional Theme Leadership (Quality & Mobility):

  • Set the bar regionally: Define positioning, content strategy, and integrated campaigns for Quality & Mobility.
  • Scale best practices: Align global messaging with LATAM needs; enable knowledge-sharing and consistent activation across countries.

What you bring:

  • Strategic clarity & executional rigor: You turn business goals into actionable programs that deliver measurable impact.
  • Proven demand gen: History of campaigns that drive MQLs, pipeline, and conversion in complex B2B environments.
  • LATAM expertise: Deep understanding of Mexico and broader LATAM buyer behavior, channels, and regulatory nuances.
  • Localization mastery: You have experience in tailoring global content/messages for maximum regional relevance.
  • Relationship builder: Confident collaborator across Sales, Training, and global teams.
  • Operational savvy: Budget management, vendor oversight, and performance reporting are second nature.
  • Martech fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce and Pardot (required); familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, SEO/SEM, paid media, and ABM tactics.
  • Organized & adaptable: Comfortable switching from big-picture strategy to precise execution; continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Segment & persona chops: You tailor narratives and offers by industry, role, and stage to move deals forward.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 6+ years progressive B2B marketing experience (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries ideal), including 3+ years leading people.
  • Proven experience executing marketing across Mexico and broader LATAM.
  • Success running multi-channel GTM in a complex organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop marketing professionals and foster cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong digital demand gen/ABM background and CRM-led workflows (Salesforce/Pardot required).
  • Familiarity with ISO, assurance, training, or compliance services (preferred).
  • Knowledge of Quality or Mobility sectors (preferred).

Language Requirements

A strong command of English, Spanish, and Portuguese is essential - both verbal and written. Please submit your application in English.

BSI - Your Partner in Progress

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organizations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team then please apply now!

What we offer

BSI offers a competitive salary, 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, vacation bonus, medical insurance, life insurance, savings fund with company contribution, meal allowance, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization — all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Especialista em segurança da informação
description:

Atuar na operação, gestão e evolução da Segurança da Informação, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais, a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas e regulamentos.   • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE)

  • Análise de segurança, gestão de riscos e testes de invasão.

title: Especialista de Segurança da Informação
description:

title: Usuário Final do Arquiteto de Domínio
description:
Junte-se a uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que se juntar à TCS? Aqui na TCS, acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença. Por isso, cultivamos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo, repleta de oportunidades de aprimoramento e desenvolvimento mútuo. Estamos buscando um Usuário Final do Arquiteto de Domínio , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em um contrato CLT, remoto .

Descrição do cargo:

O Arquiteto de Domínio – Computação do Usuário Final tem a responsabilidade de projetar, governar e evoluir as arquiteturas que suportam a experiência do usuário final nas operações da Brasil e Canadá. Isso inclui dispositivos, desktops, laptops, dispositivos móveis, virtualização, colaboração, suporte remoto e soluções de espaço de trabalho digital. O objetivo é oferecer ambientes modernos, seguros e eficientes, alinhados às necessidades dos usuários, garantindo alta disponibilidade, facilidade de uso e integração com plataformas corporativas.

Esse profissional trabalhará colaborativamente para implementar soluções inovadoras que promovam produtividade, segurança, automação e mobilidade, respeitando a governança internacional e os padrões de segurança, e com uma visão clara de transformação digital centrada no usuário.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir e manter arquiteturas de ponta a ponta para ambientes de Computação do Usuário Final (EUC), abrangendo dispositivos físicos, virtuais, móveis, desktops virtuais (VDI), BYOD e de colaboração.
  • Estabelecer padrões e estruturas para provisionamento, gerenciamento e segurança de dispositivos, incluindo políticas de acesso, controle de identidade (IAM), criptografia e proteção contra ameaças.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização e transformação digital para espaços de trabalho inteligentes, com foco em automação, autoatendimento, integração com nuvem, colaboração (MS Teams, Zoom) e aplicações móveis.
  • Avaliar e implementar virtualização, gerenciamento de dispositivos móveis (MDM), segurança de endpoints (EDR), zero-trust, monitoramento e tecnologias de suporte remoto.
  • Trabalhe proativamente para resolver desafios de desempenho, escalabilidade e disponibilidade, garantindo suporte para trabalho remoto e híbrido.
  • Colabore com TI, segurança, negócios e operações para alinhar as demandas e promover a melhor experiência do usuário final.
  • Promover uma governança eficaz, cumprindo as regulamentações globais (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) e as políticas internas.
  • Produzir documentação completa, guias, planos de contingência, treinamentos e melhores práticas para equipes de apoio e operações.
  • Participe de fóruns, workshops e projetos de inovação para manter o ambiente tecnológico alinhado com as tendências globais.

Requisitos e Competências

Requisitos Essenciais (Habilidades Técnicas)

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas similares.
  • Sólida experiência (mínimo 8 anos) em arquitetura, gestão e inovação do ambiente de Computação para Usuários Finais, em empresas globais ou setores altamente complexos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas e ferramentas EUC: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), ferramentas de colaboração (Teams, Zoom).
  • Expertise em segurança de dispositivos, zero trust, gerenciamento de identidade e acesso (Azure AD, Okta), criptografia, proteção de endpoints, automação e monitoramento.
  • Experiência com ambientes de trabalho híbridos e remotos, suporte técnico avançado e estratégias para maximizar produtividade e segurança.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação técnica global, português avançado para alinhamento Brasil-Canadá.

Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes técnicas, usuários finais e executivos.
  • Habilidades analíticas, orientação para soluções e inovação centrada no usuário.
  • Liderança, influência e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes multiculturais e colaborativos.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em entregar valor contínuo.

Diferenciais / Bom ter:

  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, Prince2) ou Gestão de Mudanças (PROSCI Certified Change Practitioner).
  • Experiência específica no setor de mineração, transformação digital ou grandes iniciativas globais.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas digitais para Gestão de Mudanças e comunicação colaborativa (MS Teams, SharePoint, Yammer, etc.).

Habilidades e Entregáveis Esperadas, Impacto:

  • Arquitetura sólida e escalável do ambiente de computação para usuários finais para, Brasil e Canadá.
  • Modernização e automação dos espaços de trabalho, com melhorias substanciais na experiência do usuário final.
  • Garantindo segurança, conformidade e disponibilidade em ambientes distribuídos e híbridos.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact; transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .

With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films; it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.

On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!

What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As Marketing Manager, Brazil , you will lead the development and execution of Peliplat’s local marketing strategy , driving user growth, engagement, and brand positioning in the Brazilian market.

This is a hands-on strategic role : you will not only execute campaigns but also define how Peliplat wins in Brazil —from influencer strategy and community growth to viral campaigns and cultural positioning.

You will work closely with global teams (Product, Content, BD) while acting as the local market expert , ensuring our product and messaging resonate deeply with Brazilian audiences.

Responsibilities

Market Strategy & Growth Ownership

  • Define and execute Peliplat’s go-to-market strategy for Brazil , aligned with company growth targets (downloads, DAU, retention, subscriptions), with emphasis on Mobile Application Development.
  • Localize global strategies to fit the Brazilian audience behaviour, trends, and cultural nuances
  • Identify growth opportunities through viral loops, partnerships, and community-driven mechanics
  • Act as the key voice of the Brazilian market internally

User Acquisition & Campaign Execution

  • Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns , focusing on organic and viral growth channels
  • Develop referral programs, co-watching campaigns, and “watch with friends” mechanics
  • Collaborate with paid media teams (when applicable) to optimize performance campaigns
  • Continuously test and iterate growth strategies based on performance data

Influencer & Creator Strategy

  • Build and manage relationships with Brazilian influencers, film critics, and content creators
  • Identify and onboard creators to host Virtual Screening Rooms and co-watching events
  • Develop scalable influencer programs (from top-tier KOLs to micro-creators)
  • Leverage the “100% revenue to creators” model to attract and retain talent

Community & Event Marketing

  • Drive adoption of Virtual Screening Rooms as core user behaviour
  • Plan and execute high-impact events (e.g., “Watch with (Influencer)”, themed screenings, premieres)
  • Foster a strong community culture through interactive campaigns and social engagement
  • Collaborate with operations teams to ensure successful event execution

Content & Social Media Strategy

  • Define content direction for Brazil across TikTok, Instagram, and other relevant platforms
  • Identify viral content formats (reaction videos, co-watching clips, film discussions)
  • Collaborate with content and ops teams to turn in-app moments into shareable external content
  • Ensure consistent brand voice and cultural relevance

Data-Driven Optimization

  • Track and analyze key metrics: installs, activation, retention, DAU/MAU, engagement
  • Use insights to refine campaigns, content, and user journeys
  • Identify behavioral patterns and optimize funnel performance
  • Report on market performance and recommend strategic adjustments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product to provide feedback on user experience and localization needs
  • Collaborate with BD and Content teams on creator partnerships and programming
  • Align with global marketing while advocating for Brazil-specific strategies
  • Support long-term brand building and market expansion plans

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in marketing, growth, or community roles , ideally in tech, media, or entertainment
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian digital landscape , including social media and influencer ecosystems
  • Proven experience driving user growth, engagement, or community-building initiatives
  • Experience working with influencers, creators, or content-driven platforms
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions
  • Fluent in Portuguese (native level) and strong English proficiency

Who you are

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Deep understanding of internet culture and trends in Brazil
  • Creative thinker with strong execution ability
  • Comfortable balancing strategy and hands-on work
  • Adaptable, fast-moving, and results-driven

Extra Points if you...

  • Passion for film, entertainment, or online communities
  • Experience with short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, etc.)
  • Background in startups or fast-scaling products
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or community-driven platforms

Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder
  • Strategic Hustle — Create Value Beyond Budget
  • Problem-Solving — Decode Complexity
  • Result Oriented — Drive Real Impact
  • Market Intelligence — Know the Game
  • Passion for Cinema & Community — Build What You Believe In
