title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.

Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.

Who We Are Looking For:

We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.

The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.

The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.

Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.

Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month

Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Security BISO/PMO

Resumo:

O Security BISO/PMO atua como um elo estratégico entre as unidades de tecnologia, negócio e a organização de cibersegurança. Essa função garante que as iniciativas de segurança estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, enquanto gerencia a entrega de projetos de segurança em toda a empresa. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança, priorizar demandas de segurança e supervisionar planos e execução de projetos para reduzir riscos e impulsionar o crescimento do negócio.

Responsabilidades:

Alinhamento com o Negócio:

  • Servir como ponto de contato principal para as unidades de negócio em relação às necessidades e iniciativas de cibersegurança.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em estratégias e soluções de segurança acionáveis junto às demais equipes de cibersegurança.
  • Defender a segurança nos processos de negócio, garantindo conformidade com padrões regulatórios e organizacionais.

Gestão de Programas e Projetos:

  • Liderar e gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de segurança, garantindo entrega dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento.
  • Desenvolver e manter planos de projeto, registros de riscos e relatórios de status para as partes interessadas.
  • Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, incluindo TI, segurança e stakeholders de negócio, para atingir os objetivos dos projetos.

Governança e Relatórios:

  • Estabelecer e manter estruturas de governança para programas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas relacionadas às iniciativas de segurança.
  • Garantir alinhamento com requisitos de gestão de riscos corporativos e conformidade.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificar, avaliar e priorizar riscos de segurança que impactam as operações do negócio e alinhar com o registro de riscos do GRC.
  • Colaborar com líderes de negócio para implementar estratégias de mitigação de riscos.

Engajamento com Stakeholders:

  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com executivos, líderes de negócio e equipes técnicas.

  • Alta proficiência e experiência prática com metodologias de gestão de projetos, planejamento e entrega, como PMBOK e Agile.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.

Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities

title: SAO PAULO - [HYBRID] - L2 SOC Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.

We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.

Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.

2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.

3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.

Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.

Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.

Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).

What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Senior QA Analyst - Live Games
description:
We're looking for a talented and detail-obsessed Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join Wildlife's Quality Assurance team, focused on our Live Games portfolio.

As a Senior QA Analyst, you will be responsible for estimating, planning, and executing test cases across our live titles — evaluating risks and impact, defining quality strategy, and helping the team grow through knowledge sharing. You will communicate testing demands and quality metrics to both developers and other analysts, owning the bridge between QA and engineering.

This role starts with broad coverage across all Wildlife live games, with the longer-term path of migrating into a single high-impact title as ownership deepens. Professional posture, sharp communication, and influence skills are essential - even though this is not a people-management role, you will interact across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.

The right person for this position is curious by nature, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and thrives in a fast-paced live operations context where every build matters.

What You'll Do

  • Execute manual testing with a meticulous eye across Wildlife's live games portfolio, ensuring every build meets our quality bar before reaching millions of daily players.
  • Own the end-to-end bug flow: identify, reproduce, write clear bug reports, prioritize based on impact, and decide whether issues go to backlog or require immediate fix.
  • Write, refine, and continuously optimize test cases - leveraging AI tools (Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate case creation and improve description quality at scale.
  • Apply AI-assisted build analysis: compare build A vs build B by analyzing code diffs (via Cursor), identifying changed files, and using structured prompts to surface high-risk areas before testing begins.
  • Hunt corner cases - go beyond the happy path to find edge scenarios that no one else catches, before players do.
  • Deploy builds on physical devices (iOS and Android), validating real-world behavior, performance, and UX.
  • Monitor and analyze post-release quality using Firebase, Crashlytics, and internal QA tooling (QA Hub).
  • Define and evolve quality metrics that engineering and product use to make decisions - not just report them.
  • Collaborate directly with engineering on debugging, prioritization, and release decisions.
  • Provide your team with a quality strategy that supports delivery goals and aligns with Wildlife's overall quality strategy.
  • Advocate for user experience and game quality across product, design, and engineering conversations.
  • Participate as one of the first analysts on new game projects when needed - helping new dev teams establish quality processes and standards from the ground up.

What You'll Need

  • University degree in computing-related fields (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development) - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Previous professional experience in software development or game testing, with at least 2 consecutive years in mobile games or high-cadence live operations environments.
  • Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis.
  • Solid command of software testing concepts: testability, escape rate, regression, unit, integration, soak, stress, and test automation.
  • Demonstrated experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, or equivalent crash analytics and monitoring tooling in production environments.
  • Track record of writing, structuring, and optimizing test cases with method - not just executing scripts written by others.
  • Proven ability to identify non-obvious corner cases, with concrete examples of critical bugs you found that others missed.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and validating builds on physical iOS and Android devices.
  • Active use of AI in your QA workflow - Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent tools applied to code analysis, test case generation, or debugging.
  • Clear technical communication - you can speak the developer's language without losing the quality lens.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with live games at scale (millions of DAU).
  • Track record of creating quality metrics that were adopted by engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with Unity, C#, or mobile-native stacks.
  • Experience with mobile test automation (Appium, XCTest, Espresso) - even though this role is primarily manual.
  • Understanding of DevOps tools such as Chef, Ansible, Jenkins, or similar.

More About You

  • You're passionate about games and about software development - and you know how to ensure its quality.
  • You thrive in agile environments and stimulate that mindset in your team.
  • You're creative when solving problems and continuously seek improvements in processes and solutions.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and the broader company to identify issues and align demands.
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes on the final result.
  • You are professionally postured and exercise influence even outside of formal leadership roles - knowing how to interact with multiple disciplines and higher job levels with credibility.

How We Work

This role is hybrid, with 3 days per week in our Itaim Bibi office (São Paulo). The in-person time is a deliberate accelerator for pair debugging, faster decisions with engineering, and high-bandwidth alignment. The remaining 2 days are remote.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come.

Equal Opportunity

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Gerente financeiro
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to partner with the Managing Director and the market team to deliver the business plan and support operational execution. This is a managerial role focused on leadership, planning and process improvement, with also some hands-on operational tasks.

Key responsibilities

Financial and operational leadership

• Act as a trusted business partner to the Managing Director and the wider market team to deliver budget and strategy. • Own the annual budget, periodic reforecasts and the monthly forward-looking risks & opportunities view, and drive commercial action plans where required. • Break the business plan and budget into measurable building blocks and KPIs, ensure they are tracked by the FP&A team and by functional partners, and lead corrective actions when performance deviates from target. • Track return on key investments, including capex for new sales initiatives, and provide actionable analysis to improve outcomes. • Provide hands-on operational support to ensure an accurate and timely close, with an initial high level of involvement expected, followed by a substantial reduction as processes are stabilized and effectively managed by the new financial manager.

Finance team leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing finance function aligned to company strategy. • Line-manage and mentor key direct reports (for example Financial Control, treasury, Billing and Cash Collection), ensuring the right people are in the right roles. • Foster collaboration between finance and commercial teams to embed financial discipline across the market.

Process leadership

• Identify and prioritise process improvements across the business (for example debtor management) and drive execution to close the gaps. • Work with the Group finance community to implement best practices and share learnings that other markets can adopt.

Reporting and compliance

• Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual reporting that meets Group and third-party obligations and that tracks progress against business goals and KPIs. • Plan and oversee the annual audit and tax filings, working with the Group tax and control teams to optimise outcomes. • Support wider reporting requirements such as CSRD and other regulatory or sustainability disclosures as required.

Liquidity and cash management

• Drive delivery against cash targets, ensuring profit is converted into cash. • Assign ownership and targets for each element of working capital, and drive process improvements where necessary. • Maintain a 13-week cash flow forecast and a budgeted liquidity plan. • Coordinate with Group to repatriate cash to the parent company in line with the plan.

Project leadership

• Lead ad-hoc strategic projects, including business cases for commercial opportunities and support for acquisitions or integrations as they arise. • Provide commercial and financial analysis to support decision making and monitor project outcomes.

Desired experience and skills

• Proven finance manager experience in a commercial environment, ideally with exposure to FP&A, financial control and cash management. • Strong analytical skills and experience converting financial insight into commercial action. • Experience leading finance teams and developing talent. • Comfortable working with ERP systems and driving process improvements. • Hands-on month-end close experience and a pragmatic approach to resolving operational issues. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Médico Intensivista (Vaga Afirmativa)
description:
ESTA VAGA PRIORIZA pessoas negras, indígenas, com deficiência e/ou trans , de acordo com a portaria GM/MS Nº 5.801, de 28 de novembro de 2024.

Olá, somos o Hospital Sírio-Libanês!

Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.

Nos orgulhamos do nosso caráter filantrópico, de um compromisso social genuíno e de sermos uma das melhores instituições de saúde do mundo reconhecida pela revista Newsweek (2023) além de sermos uma empresa TOP Employers , nos destacando entre as melhores instituições do mundo em práticas de Recursos Humanos.

Desta maneira, acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade.

Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!

Sírio-Libanês para todos e todas!

Acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura, por isso respeitamos as individualidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas que acreditam em seu potencial e detêm os requisitos técnicos para executar a função escolhida. Você pode participar dos nossos processos seletivos independentemente de deficiência, raça, etnia, idade, religião, sexo biológico, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, expressão de gênero ou biótipo.

O Sírio-Libanês é uma instituição plural e queremos ser cada vez mais. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade!

O que você vai encontrar neste desafio?

Estamos vivendo em um mundo que está passando por grandes transformações de maneira rápida. Um mundo cada vez mais ágil e digital. Acreditamos na mudança e evolução para sermos cada vez melhores, buscando uma experiência inspiradora.

Por isso, pensando na nossa experiência, queremos ouvir e cuidar cada vez mais das nossas pessoas. Nossa principal missão é incentivar a transformação organizacional por meio da influência, sendo provocador das mudanças que possam elevar a um patamar de inovação e tecnologia para alavancar cada vez mais a competitividade, sem deixar de pensar no nosso potencial, em sermos extraordinários e evoluirmos na jornada do colaborador.

Neste desafio você será responsável por:

  • Responsável pela assistência médica para os pacientes internados nas unidades críticas de pacientes adultos;
  • Conhecer os detalhes dos casos, atentando para todas as suas dimensões e traçando o seu plano de cuidado;
  • Participar da visita multiprofissional à beira leito, registrando o plano de cuidados dos pacientes;
  • Compartilhar a visão do paciente crítico com as demais equipes assistenciais, buscando participar das decisões e negociar diferentes pontos de vista;
  • Possuir habilidades de acolhimento e empatia, além de capacidade de resolução de conflitos entre equipe médica/assistencial e familiares;
  • Exercer proatividade para antever e resolver problemas que envolvam o atendimento ao paciente.

Para este desafio você precisará:

  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • Residência em Terapia Intensiva ou Título de Especialista em Terapia Intensiva pela AMIB;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na assistência a pacientes críticos após a conclusão da especialização;

title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem

Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: Talent Acquisition Sr Analyst
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a member of the talent acquisition team, you'll have the opportunity to work in a cross-regional team with international exposure. We spot, engage and hire the top talents to join DiDi. We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.

In this role you will be...

  • Responsible to manage the full end-to-end hiring cycle for roles across multiple teams in the organization.
  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders; providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.
  • Using data to make decisions that facilitate hiring and allows the organization to make the best hiring decision.
  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.
  • Working in projects that impact how we shape a culture of recruiting.

We are eager to be in touch with you because you have...

  • 3-4 years of experience in recruiting (preferably in a fast-paced environment such as the internet or consulting companies).
  • Experience using ATS systems (lever, greenhouse, icims, etc).
  • Strong verbal and written communication in English and spanish.
  • Excited about driving change and helping the organization evolve.
  • Knowledgeable about talent acquisition techniques (offer negotiation, sourcing, etc).

You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Res p eito, Integridade, Meritocracia, Foco no Cliente, Empreendedorismo

title: ANALISTA DE DEPARTAMENTO PESSOAL JUNIOR - RESPONSAVEL PELA JORNADA DO COLABORADOR (PONTO)
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.

Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerar planilhas de conferência, relatórios de auditoria e análises de divergências de ponto;
  • Efetuar atendimento das demandas dos colaboradores e gestores do Grupo Petrópolis em temas relacionados a jornada, de acordo com a priorização do fechamento do ponto e SLA de atendimento definido;
  • Realizar manutenções de ausências, afastamentos, trocas de turno e banco de horas individual no SAP, garantindo registros corretos para a folha de pagamento;
  • Auxiliar na emissão de relatórios de banco de horas e horas extras, contribuindo para acompanhamento e planos de ação;
  • Cadastrar colaboradores no banco de dados dos relógios de ponto, assegurando atualização e funcionalidade do processo de marcações;
  • Acompanhar o funcionamento dos relógios de ponto e catracas, analisando marcações travadas e dispositivos off-line, além de identificar necessidade de manutenção ou troca;

  • Liberar aparelhos (corporativos e pessoais) para acesso ao sistema de ponto Mobile e incluir usuários no banco de dados;
  • Manter atualizado semanalmente o banco de dados do Mobile, incluindo exclusões de usuários desligados.

A Viral Coach ajuda empresas a aumentarem sua visibilidade e presença de marca por meio de redes sociais orgânicas, anúncios pagos e estratégias de marketing digital.   • Gestão de mais de US$ 5 milhões em investimento total em anúncios
  • Experiência gerenciando 45+ contas simultaneamente em agência ou ambiente de alto volume
  • Forte entendimento de marketing, funis e otimização de conversão
  • Habilidade analítica para interpretar dados e orientar decisões estratégicas

  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a resultados

Salário base de US$ 2.750 mensais , com possibilidade de bônus por desempenho.

Explicação detalhada da remuneração:

OTE (ganhos totais estimados): entre US$ 3.875 e US$ 5.000 mensais

Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo, com alto padrão de performance e zero drama. Crescemos quando nossos clientes crescem.

Suporte

Cultura colaborativa de alta performance, focada em extrair o melhor de cada membro do time.

Nosso processo avalia experiência, abordagem e alinhamento com os valores da Viral Coach.

Inclui um vídeo inicial de apresentação e, para candidatos selecionados, um teste prático com análise de dados de campanhas e recomendações estratégicas.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.

Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.

This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.

We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.

If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!

Job challenges:

- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;

- Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;

- Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;

- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.

- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.

- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;

- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;

- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;

- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;

- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);

- Intermediate Excel skills;

Benefits we offer:

- Food allowance;

- Transportation allowance without discount;

- Health and dental plan at no cost;

- Life insurance;

- Private pension;

- Profit-Sharing;

- WellHub Membership.

If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.

title: Analista de segurança da informação
description:
Somos o Grupo NTSEC uma plataforma de soluções em cibersegurança que integra a força da NTSec, InfoSec, Zivasec e CloudSec. Com mais de 300 Secpowers espalhados pelo Brasil e escritórios em 10 estados, estamos em franca expansão.

Há mais de 18 anos , garantimos que redes, infraestruturas e dados estejam seguros, estáveis e com alto desempenho. Somos referência no setor, com parcerias globais e 4 vezes reconhecidos como Great Place to Work™

Buscamos um Analista de Segurança da Informação com foco em Endpoint para atuar na administração e sustentação de soluções corporativas de proteção, como EDR, XDR e NGAV. Aqui, você será responsável por analisar alertas, investigar incidentes, implementar estratégias de tuning e atuar na resposta a ameaças, garantindo a melhoria contínua da postura de segurança dos nossos clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Administrar e sustentar soluções corporativas de proteção de endpoint (EDR/XDR/NGAV);
  • Realizar análise de alertas de segurança e investigação de incidentes envolvendo endpoints;
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de tuning para melhoria da qualidade de detecção e redução de falsos positivos;
  • Atuar na resposta a incidentes relacionados a endpoints, incluindo contenção e análise inicial de causa;
  • Apoiar a integração da solução de endpoint com ferramentas complementares de segurança (SIEM, SOAR, entre outras);
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da postura de segurança dos ambientes monitorados;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e apoiar reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Experiência prévia com soluções corporativas de proteção de endpoint.
  • Conhecimento em investigação de alertas e análise de eventos de segurança, em sistemas operacionais Windows/Linux, noções de troubleshooting e em conceitos de resposta a incidentes.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança, como MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Postura técnica proativa.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência prática com soluções de EDR/XDR corporativas e em ambientes NOC, SOC ou MSS.
  • Experiência com plataformas da Trend Micro, tais como: Trend Micro Vision One; Trend Micro Apex One; Trend Micro Deep Security / Workload Security;
  • Certificações: Trend Micro Certified Professional – Vision One, Trend Micro Certified Professional – Endpoint Security, Trend Micro Certified Professional – Workload Security (Deep Security), CompTIA Security+ e/ou Certificações relacionadas a EDR ou análise de incidentes.

title: Application Engineer
description:
You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

What You'll Build

Example products in the pipeline

· AI Candidate Matching Engine — Match candidates to job openings using semantic search, skill extraction, and intelligent ranking.

· Intelligent Onboarding Agent — An agentic system that guides new hires through credentialing, document collection, compliance checks, and first-day preparation. Replaces manual follow-up chains.

· Recruiter Copilot — An AI assistant embedded in recruiters' daily workflow. Surfaces candidate suggestions, drafts outreach, summarizes conversations, and flags placement risks.

· Conversational BI — Natural language interface to business data. Users ask questions in plain English, get charts, tables, and insights back.

What You'll Do

· Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources

· Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection

· Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications

· Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems

· Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality

· Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available

· Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically

· Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

· Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.

· Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it

· Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar

· Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management

· Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures

· Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)

· Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging

· Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

· Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops

· Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work

· Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)

· Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings

· Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services

· Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing

· Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or Azure ecosystem

Who You Are

· You graduated recently (1-3 years ago) and have already gotten your hands dirty building real AI applications in a real organization — internship, first job, startup, or contract work

· You're more of a builder than a researcher. You care about shipping products, not publishing papers.

· You're excited by the pace of LLM innovation and naturally stay up to date with new models, frameworks, and techniques

· You're comfortable with ambiguity. Some of these products don't have a playbook — you'll figure it out with the team.

· You're autonomous but collaborative. You can own a product end-to-end but also work closely with data engineers and product stakeholders.

Why This Role

· Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.

· Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.

· Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.

· Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: Técnico Segurança do Trabalho Sênior (Logística Estradas))
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time?

Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Localidade:

Mato Grosso do Sul

Desafio:

Implementar, monitorar e assegurar o cumprimento das normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho (SST) na fábrica, logística, ferrovia ou porto, identificando riscos, propondo medidas preventivas, promovendo treinamentos e garantindo a proteção dos colaboradores, do patrimônio e do meio ambiente, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho seguro e em conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Principais Atividades:

  • Identificar e controlar riscos, através de inspeções periódicas nas áreas da fábrica, logística, ferrovia ou porto, acompanhando as condições de trabalho, como níveis de ruído, temperatura, iluminação, exposição a agentes químicos, físicos ou biológicos, uso correto e manutenção dos EPIs, para identificar riscos de acidentes e propor medidas corretivas e preventivas;
  • Implementar e monitorar o cumprimento das NRs aplicáveis, nas áreas da fábrica, logística, ferrovia e porto, como NR-12 (Máquinas e Equipamentos), NR-13: Caldeiras e Vasos de Pressão, NR-33 (Espaços Confinados) e NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura) entre outras;
  • Elaborar e atualizar programas e documentos, como PGR (Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), e LTCAT (Laudo Técnico de Condições Ambientais do Trabalho);
  • Ministrar treinamentos periódicos sobre segurança do trabalho, prevenção de acidentes, uso de EPIs e procedimentos de emergência, bem como treinar equipes em atividades críticas, como trabalho em altura, espaços confinados e manuseio de produtos químicos;
  • Realizar o processo de integração para novos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, apresentando as normas de segurança da Arauco;
  • Atuar no processo de investigação de acidentes e incidentes, investigando, identificando a causa raiz e propondo ações corretivas e preventivas, posteriormente elaborar o relatório detalhado da ocorrência, com as melhorias que evitarão recorrências;
  • Participar da gestão dos indicadores da área tais como Taxa de Frequência, Taxa de Gravidade, Número de incidentes entre outros, atualizando dados da sua área de atuação, acompanhando, analisando e sugerindo melhorias;
  • Promover campanhas educativas relacionadas à saúde e segurança, como prevenção de doenças ocupacionais, combate ao alcoolismo e ergonomia;
  • Fiscalizar a atuação de empresas terceirizadas para garantir que suas atividades estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança da Arauco, exigindo documentação como Permissão de Trabalho (PT) e Análise Preliminar de Risco (APR);
  • Participar da elaboração e implementação do Plano de Ação de Emergência (PAE), garantindo que esteja atualizado e adequado às particularidades de sua área de atuação (Fábrica, logística, ferrovia e Porto);
  • Realizar simulados periódicos de evacuação, combate a incêndios e contenção de vazamentos, assim como garantir que as brigadas de emergência estejam treinadas e operacionais;
  • Acompanhar auditorias de segurança do trabalho realizadas por órgãos reguladores (ex.: Ministério do Trabalho) e por clientes ou certificadoras, respondendo a não conformidades e implementando ações corretivas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do trabalho concluída;
  • Conhecimento da Legislação trabalhista e normas regulamentadoras aplicáveis ao setor industrial, Logística, Ferrovia e Porto (NRs);
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise de risco, como APR e Mapeamento de Riscos;
  • Domínio de programas de saúde e segurança: PCMSO, PGR;
  • Habilidade com sistemas de gestão de segurança;
  • Excel nível intermediário.

Diferencial

  • Inglês nível intermediário
  • Espanhol
  • Habilidades com ferramentas de BI

title: Engenheiro de rede sênior
description:
Responsável por projetar, implementar e manter a infraestrutura crítica de redes que suporta um ecossistema multi-cloud e multicanal. O desafio envolve gerenciar conectividade de alta disponibilidade para transações financeiras e de loteria, integrando redes móveis, ambientes de Contact Center (CCX/CCaaS) e roteamento complexo entre data centers físicos e provedores de nuvem, garantindo segurança e desempenho de ponta a ponta.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Roteamento e Core Switching: Gerenciar protocolos de roteamento dinâmico, com foco obrigatório em BGP para interconexão de sistemas autônomos e tráfego multi-homed.

• Conectividade Híbrida e Cloud: Implementar e gerenciar roteamento em ambientes de nuvem (AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN), garantindo comunicação fluida entre ambientes on-premises e instâncias em nuvem.

• Segurança de Perímetro e VPN: Configurar e manter túneis VPN (Site-to-Site e Client-to-Site) e infraestrutura de Firewall, com domínio em tecnologias Cisco e/ou Fortinet.

• Infraestrutura de Voz e Contact Center: Sustentar e otimizar ambientes Cisco Unified Contact Center Express (CCX) e integração com soluções CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service), garantindo Qualidade de Serviço (QoS) de voz.

• Mobilidade e Redes Sem Fio: Projetar e gerenciar redes Wi-Fi corporativas de alta densidade e configurar integração com redes móveis (4G/5G) para redundância de terminais de loteria e POS.

• Monitoramento e Performance: Utilizar ferramentas e protocolos de análise de tráfego (Wireshark, SNMP) para troubleshooting avançado e otimização de latência em transações críticas.

• Suporte a Projetos Multicanais: Garantir que a rede suporte a jornada do cliente em todos os canais (Físico, Web e App), mantendo segmentação de rede e segurança de dados em conformidade com PCI-DSS e LGPD/GDPR.

• Qualidade e Governança: Atuar em conformidade com diretrizes ISO 9001, ISO 27001, políticas de Jogo Responsável e garantir a confidencialidade das informações da organização

title: Senior Software Engineer - Game Technology
description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo.

At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day.

Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs.
  • Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes.
  • Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast.
  • Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.
  • Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality.
  • Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming.
  • Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale.
  • Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.
  • Working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development.
  • Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure.
  • Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.

MORE ABOUT YOU

You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it.

ABOUT WILDLIFE

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Analista Segurança do Trabalho Sênior
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time?

Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Localidade:

Santos/SP

Desafio:

Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar programas e ações voltados à segurança e saúde dos colaboradores em sua área de atuação (Fábrica, logística ou Porto), garantindo conformidade com normas regulamentadoras (NRs), prevenindo acidentes, mitigando riscos ocupacionais e promovendo uma cultura organizacional voltada à segurança.

Principais Atividades:

  • Elaborar, implementar e revisar políticas internas de segurança do trabalho, alinhadas às exigências legais e às necessidades operacionais em sua área de atuação;
  • Assegurar a manutenção e atualização dos programas como PGR (Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), PCMSO (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional) e LTCAT (Laudo Técnico das Condições Ambientais de Trabalho), conforme legislação vigente;
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas nas áreas operacionais e administrativas (Fábrica, logística ou Porto) em colaboradores próprios e terceiros, identificando riscos e propondo medidas de controle;
  • Realizar a gestão de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs), garantindo que o fornecedor parceiro mantenha a estoques mínimos dos EPIs mais usado ou com maior desgaste, bem como, assegurar a utilização e manutenção correta dos por parte dos colaboradores;
  • Participar da investigação de acidentes e quase-acidentes, utilizando metodologias que possibilitem a identificação das causas, implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, visando a segurança dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros;
  • Ministrar treinamentos sobre temas como NR-12 (Segurança em Máquinas), NR-33 (Espaços Confinados), NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura) e outros relacionados à indústria de celulose, logística ou porto, habilitando profissionais para emissão e liberação de Permissões de Trabalhos (PT);
  • Promover programas de integração com foco em segurança para novos contratados e terceiros, aplicando avaliação de aproveitamento dos assuntos abordados, garantindo e reforçando a cultura de segurança da Arauco;
  • Garantir que as operações da fábrica estejam em conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras e outras exigências legais aplicáveis, assim como, atuar como ponto de contato durante inspeções e auditorias de órgãos reguladores, apresentando documentos e relatórios pertinentes;
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores-chave de segurança, como taxa de acidentes, frequência e gravidade de incidentes e elaborar relatórios periódicos para a alta gestão com análises de desempenho e propostas de melhoria;
  • Desenvolver e revisar planos de ação para emergências, como incêndios, vazamentos químicos e acidentes graves;
  • Promover simulados, exercícios práticos para treinar equipes em resposta a situações críticas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho, Tecnologia em Segurança do Trabalho ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimentos específicos em NRs aplicáveis à indústria de celulose, como NR-12, NR-33 e NR-35;
  • Conhecimentos em legislação de saúde ocupacional
  • Excel intermediário
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de BI

Diferencial

  • Inglês nível Intermediário
  • Espanhol
  • Habilidade com sistema SAP

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

  • Analisar e identificar se as soluções de monitoramento estão adequadas aos sistemas que estão sendo executados em produção, de forma a prevenir e minimizar incidentes; Experiência em otimização e performance de aplicação, queries e objetos (store procedures, functions, triggers, etc) de banco de dados.

description:
